title: Secret Pentagon program to build weapons from recovered UFO technology
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Secret Pentagon program to build weapons from recovered UFO technology, about 2007-2017 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was involved in the program uh that the pent had a secret program uh Above Top Secret the the real elements of the program where they were attempting to develop a weapon system an advanced weapon system uh using the technology that they'd recovered from UFO craft

related.note: This is about the same 2007-2017 Pentagon program Elizondo was part of (AATIP). But it claims the program's real purpose was building advanced weapons from recovered UFO technology, not studying UFOs.

plain: A man named Dan Sheehan says on Jesse Michels' podcast that from about 2007 to 2017 the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US military, ran a secret program classified above top secret. He says, citing a former Pentagon official named Lou Elizondo, that the real goal was to build an advanced weapon system using technology recovered from crashed UFOs. If true, it would mean the government holds such craft and has tried to turn them into weapons.
